scope: fold/sensor-invariant univariate audit on honest dense-Prithvi features

normalization.method: unlabeled empirical rank followed by inverse-normal transform
normalization.missing: absolute values >=1000 or non-finite are replaced by the domain median
normalization.orientation: positive-minus-negative normalized mean on the opposite fit fold
normalization.invariance_rule: feature direction must agree between folds before any strength is evaluated
normalization.purpose: remove fold/sensor scale offsets and test only within-domain ranking signal

invariants: Every feature value came from an adapter that excluded the represented sample's fold.
Unlabeled domain normalization is computed separately within each fold and sensor and cannot change within-domain ordering.
Feature direction is learned only from the opposite fold and must agree in both directions.
The exact float64 current score is the logit residual floor.
Only point-gate survivors can consume paired-site bootstrap computation.
A discovery pass can only authorize a separately frozen fold-2 protocol.
Fold 2, fresh data, and exact-paper inputs are never loaded.
